45324-the-young-o-briens-being-an-accoun.title: The Young O Briens Being An Account Of Their Sojourn In Lond
45324-the-young-o-briens-being-an-accoun.creator: Denis's superlatively cheerful voice.
45324-the-young-o-briens-being-an-accoun.description: A book by Denis's superlatively cheerful voice.. squeezed Nell's fingers tightly. There was another silence. There was nothing to say. Everything had been said over and over again. The wind sent the rain beating angrily against the closed windows. The omnibus jolted and jarred over the road.

arxiv-2002-07620.title: Crossing borders in the 19th century and now — two examples of weaving a scientific network
arxiv-2002-07620.creator: R. Folk ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, Yu. Holovatch ? , ? , ?
arxiv-2002-07620.description: Abstract Scientific research is and was at all times a transnational (global) activity. In this respect, it crosses several borders: national, cultural, and ideological. Even in times when physical borders separated the scientific community, scientists kept their minds open to the ideas created beyond the walls and tried to communicate despite all the obstacles.

arxiv-2111-11222.title: Evolution of ultra-flat band in van der Waals kagome semiconductor Pd 3 P 2 (S 1-x Se x ) 8
arxiv-2111-11222.creator: Shaohua Yan 1,† , Ben-Chao Gong 1,† , Lin Wang 2 , Jinzhi Wu 1 , Qiangwei Yin 1 , Xinyu Cao 3 , Xiao Zhang 3 , Xiaofeng Liu 2,∗ , Zhong-Yi Lu 1 , Kai Liu 1,∗ , and Hechang Lei 1,∗
arxiv-2111-11222.description: Abstract We investigate the evolutions of structural parameters, optical properties, and electronic structures of van der Waals kagome semiconductor Pd 3 P 2 S 8 with Se doping. When the doping level of Se increases, the bandgaps of Pd 3 P 2 (S 1-x Se x ) 8 single crystals decrease gradually, accompanying with the expanded unit cells.

arxiv-2205-12199.title: Boosting Method for Automated Feature Space Discovery in Supervised Quantum Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2205-12199.creator: Vladimir Rastunkov, \IEEEmembership IBM Quantum, Industry & Technical Services, Jae-Eun Park, \IEEEmembership IBM Quantum, Industry & Technical Services, Abhijit Mitra, \IEEEmembership IBM Quantum, Industry & Technical Services, Brian Quanz, \IEEEmembership IBM T.J. Watson Research Center, Yorktown
arxiv-2205-12199.description: Abstract Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVM) have become an important tool in research and applications of quantum kernel methods. In this work we propose a boosting approach for building ensembles of QSVM models and assess performance improvement across multiple datasets.

arxiv-2206-14688.title: Conferences—an Owner’s Manual
arxiv-2206-14688.creator: John E. M c Carthy
arxiv-2206-14688.description: Abstract I have just attended my first in-person conferences since the start of COVID. They form a critical part of our profession, so I decided to write my opinions about how to maximize their benefits. I say nothing of online conferences, because I don’t understand them.

arxiv-2310-06768.title: The resurgence of the plateau in supersymmetric 𝒩 = 1 {\cal N}=1 Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity
arxiv-2310-06768.creator: Luca Griguolo, Jacopo Papalini, Lorenzo Russo, and Domenico Seminara
arxiv-2310-06768.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Luca Griguolo, Jacopo Papalini, Lorenzo Russo, and Domenico Seminara. Significant progresses have been made recently in understanding the spectral form factor of Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity, particularly at late times where non-perturbative effects are expected to play a dominant role. By focusing on a peculiar regime of large time and fixed temperature, called τ \tau -scaling limit, it was found that it is possible to analytically investigate the late-time plateau directly through the gravitational genus expansion.

arxiv-2403-00109.title: Versatile Optical Frequency Division with Kerr-induced Synchronization at Tunable Microcomb Synthetic Dispersive Waves
arxiv-2403-00109.creator: Grégory Moille, Pradyoth Shandilya, Alioune Niang, Curtis Menyuk, Gary Carter, Kartik Srinivasan
arxiv-2403-00109.description: Abstract Kerr-induced synchronization (KIS) provides a key tool for the control and stabilization of a dissipative Kerr soliton (DKS) frequency comb, enabled by the capture of a comb tooth by an injected reference laser. Efficient KIS relies on large locking bandwidth, meaning both the comb tooth and intracavity reference power need to be sufficiently large.

arxiv-2404-17740.title: On some relationships between the centers and the derived ideal in Leibniz 3-algebras
arxiv-2404-17740.creator: P. Ye. Minaiev, O. O. Pypka
arxiv-2404-17740.description: Abstract One of the classic results of group theory is the so-called Schur theorem. It states that if the central factor-group G / ζ ⁡ ( G ) G/\zeta(G) of a group G G is finite, then its derived subgroup [ G , G ] [G,G] is also finite. This result has numerous generalizations and modifications in group theory.

arxiv-2405-12548.title: The transition-metal-dichalcogenide family as a superconductor tuned by charge density wave strength
arxiv-2405-12548.creator: Shahar Simon, Hennadii Yerzhakov, Sajilesh K. P, Atzmon Vakahi, Sergei Remennik, Jonathan Ruhman, Maxim Khodas, Oded Millo, Hadar Steinberg
arxiv-2405-12548.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shahar Simon, Hennadii Yerzhakov, Sajilesh K. P, Atzmon Vakahi, Sergei Remennik, Jonathan Ruhman, Maxim Khodas, Oded Millo, Hadar Steinberg. Metallic transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), consisting of H-NbSe 2 , H-NbS 2 , H-TaSe 2 and H-TaS 2 , remain superconducting down to a thickness of a single layer. In these materials, thickness affects a variety of properties – including Ising protection, two-band superconductivity, and the critical temperature T C T_{C} , which decreases for the Nb-based, and increases for the Ta-based materials.

arxiv-2411-17283.title: BadScan: An Architectural Backdoor Attack on Visual State Space Models
arxiv-2411-17283.creator: Om Suhas Deshmukh, Sankalp Nagaonkar, Achyut Mani Tripathi, Ashish Mishra
arxiv-2411-17283.description: Abstract The newly introduced Visual State Space Model (VMamba), which employs State Space Mechanisms (SSM) to interpret images as sequences of patches, has shown exceptional performance compared to Vision Transformers (ViT) across various computer vision tasks. However, recent studies have highlighted that deep models are susceptible to adversarial attacks.

arxiv-2502-04776.title: Constraining parity and Lorentz violations in gravity with future ground- and space-based gravitational wave detectors
arxiv-2502-04776.creator: Bo-Yang Zhang a,b,c, Tao Zhu b,c, Jian-Ming Yan b,c, Jing-Fei Zhang a, Xin Zhang a,d,e
arxiv-2502-04776.description: Abstract The future ground- and space-based gravitational wave (GW) detectors offer unprecedented opportunities to test general relativity (GR) with greater precision. In this work, we investigate the capability of future ground-based GW detectors, the Einstein Telescope (ET) and the Cosmic Explorer (CE), and space-based GW detectors, LISA, Taiji, and TianQin, for constraining parity and Lorentz violations in gravity.

arxiv-2502-06824.title: Neural Network-based Vehicular Channel Estimation Performance: Effect of Noise in the Training Set
arxiv-2502-06824.creator: S. A. Ngorima, A. S. J. Helberg, M. H. Davel
arxiv-2502-06824.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. A. Ngorima, A. S. J. Helberg, M. H. Davel. Vehicular communication systems face significant challenges due to high mobility and rapidly changing environments, which affect the channel over which the signals travel. To address these challenges, neural network (NN)-based channel estimation methods have been suggested. These methods are primarily trained on high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) with the assumption that training a NN in less noisy conditions can result in good generalisation.

arxiv-2507-17197.title: Asymptotic stability of the 2 ​ D 2D temperature-dependent tropical climate model with the sharp decay rates
arxiv-2507-17197.creator: Hyunjin In, Dong-ha Kim, Junha Kim
arxiv-2507-17197.description: Abstract . We investigate the asymptotic stability of a tropical climate model posed on ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} , with temperature-dependent diffusion in the barotropic mode u u and linear damping in the first baroclinic mode v v . We consider two distinct cases for the barotropic component: one with linear damping and one without.

arxiv-2509-01310.title: Gender Differences in Healthcare Utilisation - Evidence from Unexpected Adverse Health Shocks
arxiv-2509-01310.creator: Nadja van ’t Hoff
arxiv-2509-01310.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nadja van ’t Hoff. This paper is the first to provide causal evidence of gender differences in healthcare utilisation to better understand the male-female health-survival paradox, where women live longer but experience worse health outcomes. Using rich Danish administrative healthcare data, we apply a staggered difference-in-differences approach that exploits the randomness in treatment timing to estimate the causal impact of adverse health shocks, such as non-fatal heart attacks or strokes, on healthcare use.

arxiv-2512-05233.title: Ratio of Intrinsic Metric to Extrinsic Metric and Volume
arxiv-2512-05233.creator: Berk Ceylan
arxiv-2512-05233.description: Abstract We study the relationship between the ratio of intrinsic to extrinsic metrics and area. For certain surfaces inside unit ball in 𝐑 3 \mathbf{R}^{3} we give lower bound on the maximum of ratio in terms of its area. We also give examples to show non-existence of global lower bounds.

arxiv-2601-15064.title: Incentive-Tuning: Understanding and Designing Incentives for Empirical Human-AI Decision-Making Studies ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Information systems Incentive schemes
arxiv-2601-15064.creator: Simran Kaur, Sara Salimzadeh, Ujwal Gadiraju
arxiv-2601-15064.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Simran Kaur, Sara Salimzadeh, Ujwal Gadiraju. While artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionised decision-making across various fields, human judgement remains paramount for high-stakes decision-making processes. This has fueled explorations of collaborative decision-making between humans and AI systems, aiming to leverage the strengths of both. To explore this dynamic, researchers conduct empirical studies , investigating how humans use AI assistance for decision-making and how this collaboration impacts results. A critical aspect of conducting these studies is the role of participants , often recruited through crowdsourcing platforms.

arxiv-2602-22858.title: Generalization of lattice Dirac operator index
arxiv-2602-22858.creator: Satoshi Yamaguchi
arxiv-2602-22858.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Satoshi Yamaguchi. We provide a comprehensive lattice formulation of various types of the Dirac operator indices, employing K K -theory to classify the Wilson Dirac operator via its spectral flow. In contrast to the index of the overlap Dirac operator defined through the Ginsparg-Wilson relation, which is restricted to flat tori in even dimensions, our formulation offers several key advantages: 1) It can be applied straightforwardly to the Atiyah-Patodi-Singer index for manifolds with boundary.

arxiv-2606-19603.creator: Zhuofan Josh Ying, Peter Hase, Nikolaus Kriegeskorte, [0.6em] Departments of Psychology, Neuroscience, Electrical Engineering

gao-gaoreports-gao-08-737t.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-737t.description: Social Security Administration Field Offices: Reduced Workforce Faces Challenges as Baby Boomers Retire (2008).

pmc-10574832.title: Sensitive and Compact Evanescent-Waveguide Optical Detector for Sugar Sensing in Commercial Beverages
pmc-10574832.creator: Alessio Buzzin, Rita Asquini, Domenico Caputo, Giampiero de Cesare, Simona Scarano, Marco Giannetto
pmc-10574832.description: This work presents a compact and sensitive refractive index sensor able to evaluate the concentration of an analyte in a sample. Its working principle leverages on the changes in the optical absorption features introduced by the sample itself on the evanescent waves of a light beam.

pmc-11459714.title: Sex and 30-day survival following out-of-hospital cardiac arrest in Scotland 2011–2020
pmc-11459714.creator: Laura A E Bijman, Sarah H Wild, Gareth Clegg, Nynke Halbesma
pmc-11459714.description: BackgroundDifferences in 30-day survival between males and females following out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) are well documented. Biological sex does not appear to be responsible for this survival gap independently of potential mediating factors. We investigated the role of potential mediating factors in the association between sex and 30-day survival after OHCA in Scotland.

pmc-11638968.title: Catalytic Enantioselective Hydrogen Atom Abstraction Enables the Asymmetric Oxidation of Meso Diols
pmc-11638968.creator: Nelson
pmc-11638968.description: Desymmetrization of meso diols is an important strategy for the synthesis of chiral oxygen-containing building blocks. Oxidative desymmetrization is an important subclass, but existing methods are often constrained by the need for activated alcohol substrates. We disclose a conceptually distinct strategy toward oxidative diol desymmetrization that is enabled by catalytic enantioselective hydrogen atom abstraction.

pmc-11646042.title: P070 Cultural determinants of Sleep Health for First Nations adolescents: Perspectives of Service Providers in Remote Communities
pmc-11646042.creator: C Ashby, M Kinghorn, R Von Senden, B Wigginton, D Sullivan, F Yaqoot, S Kalmadka, R Caple
pmc-11646042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDespite established links between sleep and mental health across the general population, sleep health within a First Nations context is less understood. Moreover, there remains a dearth of culturally responsive approaches for Australian First Nations communities, including adolescents.

pmc-11654786.title: Reconstruction of the Triceps Brachii Using the Latissimus Dorsi Musculocutaneous Flap
pmc-11654786.creator: Sachie Oda, Masayuki Okochi, Yuzo Komuro, Naoto Soejima
pmc-11654786.description: Summary:Elbow flexion is essential for the functional use of the hand. The reconstructive procedure may also change depending on the location of the sarcoma. The nonresected muscle may alter the function of the elbow. If the proximal part of the triceps muscle remains intact, it is considered functional. Functional muscle transfer is not required in such cases.

pmc-12182237.title: Identifiability investigation of within-host models of acute virus infection
pmc-12182237.creator: Yuganthi R Liyanage, Nora Heitzman-Breen, Necibe Tuncer, Stanca M Ciupe
pmc-12182237.description: Uncertainty in parameter estimates from fitting within-host models to empirical data limits the model’s ability to uncover mechanisms of infection, disease progression, and to guide pharmaceutical interventions. Understanding the effect of model structure and data availability on model predictions is important for informing model development and experimental design.

pmc-12429350.title: Efficacy of an Endoscopic Device Integrating a Sphincterotome and a Dilation Balloon Catheter for the Treatment of Choledocholithiasis (with Video)
pmc-12429350.creator: Jun-Ichi Hanatani, Koh Kitagawa, Shohei Asada, Yuki Motokawa, Yui Osaki, Tomihiro Iwata, Yukihisa Fujinaga, Norihisa Nishimura, Kosuke Kaji, Shinya Sato, Tadashi Namisaki, Akira Mitoro, Hitoshi Yoshiji, Rongqian Wu
pmc-12429350.description: Background/Objectives: The combined techniques of endoscopic sphincterotomy followed by endoscopic papillary balloon dilation (ESBD) and endoscopic sphincterotomy followed by endoscopic papillary large balloon dilation (ESLBD) have gained popularity for the endoscopic treatment of choledocholithiasis. However, the conventional approach to these procedures requires two separate devices, a sphincterotome and a balloon catheter, which can complicate and prolong the procedure.

pmc-12498039.title: Crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface studies of 4-bromo-2-chloro­phenyl (2E)-3-[4-(pent­yloxy)phen­yl]prop-2-enoate
pmc-12498039.creator: M. Harish Kumar, S. Santhosh Kumar, H. C. Devarajegowda, H. T. Srinivasa, B. S. Palakshamurthy
pmc-12498039.description: In the title compound, the aromatic rings are oriented at a dihedral angle of 83.30 (2)°. An intra­molecular C—H⋯O contact generates a five-membered S(5) ring motif. In the crystal, C—H⋯O hydrogen bonds link the mol­ecules through R12(6), R22(10), R22(14) hydrogen-bond motifs.

pmc-12598843.title: Implementation and evaluation of a psychological first aid program to manage post-traumatic stress injuries among Canadian police officers
pmc-12598843.creator: Séphora Minjoz, Delphine Collin-Vézina, Christine Genest, R Nicholas Carleton, Rosemary Ricciardelli, Sandra Moll, Geneviève St-Hilaire, Steve Geoffrion
pmc-12598843.description: BackgroundPolice officers are exposed to potentially psychological traumatic events and are at high risk of developing post-traumatic stress injuries (PTSI). Development and wide implementation of best practices for managing PTSI are needed. The psychological first aid (PFA) framework encompasses trauma-informed knowledge to guide the development of best practices.

pmc-12643590.title: Correlation of advanced lung cancer inflammation index with all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality in individuals with metabolic syndrome: Evidence from NHANES 2007–2018
pmc-12643590.creator: Long Ma, De-Sheng LI, Li-Wei Zhang, Jing-Wen Li, Yi-Chen Hou, Qing-Chao Sun
pmc-12643590.description: Metabolic syndrome is associated with persistent low-grade inflammation. The advanced lung cancer inflammation index (ALI) is a comprehensive index that measures inflammation. The purpose of this study was to determine the relationship between ALI and all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality in a metabolic syndrome (MetS) population.

pmc-13220905.title: Glue Embolus-Induced Portosplenic Thrombosis in Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt: A Novel Finding During Liver Transplantation
pmc-13220905.creator: Mayank S. Kotadia, David Saulino, Daiki Soma, Asad H. Bashir
pmc-13220905.description: Patient: Female, 62-year-old Final Diagnosis: Liver cirrhosis Symptoms: Liver failure Clinical Procedure: — Specialty: Anesthesiology • Surgery Objective: Unusual or unexpected effect of treatment BackgroundPortal vein thrombosis (PVT) in patients with cirrhosis is a significant challenge to liver transplantation and increases post-transplant morbidity and mortality, requiring advanced surgical techniques that include thrombectomy, venous grafts, and anticoagulation.

pmc-13372031.title: Systematic reviews of medical machine learning: limitations of pooling AUCs
pmc-13372031.creator: Amulya Gupta, Rahel Sileshi, Jeffrey Thompson, Amit Noheria
pmc-13372031.description: The medical literature has seen rapid growth in studies that develop and evaluate machine learning (ML) classifiers for diagnostics, accompanied by an increase in systematic reviews for synthesizing this evidence. Many such reviews use meta-analyses that pool performance metrics such as area under the receiver–operating characteristic curve (AUC), sensitivity, and specificity across ML studies.

pmc-13602325.title: Light Adjustable Lens (LAL) using Yamane intrascleral flanged fixation for traumatic aphakia: A case report
pmc-13602325.creator: Korolos Sawires, Dana Toameh, Raj Maini, Sohel Somani
pmc-13602325.description: PurposeTo describe the novel use of a Light Adjustable Lens (LAL) implanted using Yamane flanged intrascleral fixation for the management of post-traumatic aphakia without capsular support.ObservationsA 60-year-old male presented with aphakia in the right eye following remote ocular trauma during adolescence. Preoperative corrected distance visual acuity was 20/70 with a hyperopic refraction of +9.00 + 3.50 × 87.
